C1003.title: July 16 Targeted Penalty Announcement for 'Actor' Behavior
C1003.summary: On July 16, 2025, Honor of Kings issued a targeted penalty announcement for 'actor' behavior, defining it as buy-score and sell-score players manipulating match results in the same game, which seriously harms fairness. The notice said penalties would include leaderboard bans, leaderboard resets, credit score deductions, and match bans depending on impact, attached the July 16 penalty list, and said daily collection and daily bans would continue.
